scripts.clean: rm -rf dist dist-mobile dist-kiosk dist-standalone release server.js
scripts.build:all: npm run build:html-mobile && npm run build:html-kiosk && npm run build:apk
scripts.build:html-mobile: vite build --config vite.standalone.config.ts && rm -rf dist-mobile && mkdir -p dist-mobile && cp -r dist/mobile.html dist/assets dist-mobile/ && cp dist-mobile/mobile.html dist-mobile/index.html
scripts.build:html-kiosk: vite build --config vite.standalone.config.ts && rm -rf dist-kiosk && mkdir -p dist-kiosk && cp -r dist/kiosk.html dist/assets dist-kiosk/ && cp dist-kiosk/kiosk.html dist-kiosk/index.html
scripts.build:apk: npm run version:bump && npm run build:html-mobile && npx cap sync android && cd android && chmod +x gradlew && ./gradlew assembleRelease && cd .. && mkdir -p release && cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk release/GateFlame-Mobile.apk && npm run apk:fingerprint
scripts.build:apk-debug: npm run build:html-mobile && npx cap sync android && cd android && chmod +x gradlew && ./gradlew assembleDebug && cd .. && mkdir -p release && cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk release/GateFlame-Mobile-debug.apk
scripts.package:release: mkdir -p release && npm run build:html-mobile && npm run build:html-kiosk && tar -czf release/GateFlame-Complete-Package.tar.gz dist-mobile dist-kiosk && gzip -t release/GateFlame-Complete-Package.tar.gz && echo 'tarball verified: gzip OK'
